'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
***[[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[warplane]]s strike [[Syria]]'s [[Aleppo International Airport]] with [[air-to-surface missile]]s, damaging the runway and putting the [[List of airports in Syria|airport]] out of service. The [[Ministry of Transport (Syria)|Syrian transport ministry]] says that the delivery of [[humanitarian aid]] to [[Idlib Governorate|Idlib]] will be rerouted to [[Bassel Al-Assad International Airport]] in [[Latakia Governorate]] following the strike. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/7/israeli-attack-puts-syrias-aleppo-airport-out-of-service-report (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]] 
**At least six members of the [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] militant group [[Jenin Brigades]] are killed by [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] during a raid in [[Jenin]], [[West Bank]]. Among those killed is the killer of two [[Israeli settlers]] last month. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230307-israeli-troops-kill-six-during-new-raid-in-jenin (AFP via France 24)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Gulistan explosion]]
**At least 18 people are killed and more than 140 others are injured by an [[explosion]] at a commercial seven-story building in [[Gulistan, Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/bangladesh-building-explosion-kills-at-least-14-scores-hurt-/6994237.html (AFP via VOA)]
*[[2022–23 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Freddy]] becomes the longest lasting tropical cyclone on record, breaking the record previously held by [[Hurricane John (1994)]] which lasted 31 days.[https://www.cnn.com/2023/03/08/africa/cyclone-freddy-mozambique-record-storm-climate-intl/index.html/ (CNN)]
*A [[Piper J-3 Cub]] and [[Piper PA-28 Cherokee|Cherokee Piper 161]] [[Mid-air collision|collide in midair]] over [[Lake Hartridge]] in [[Florida]], [[United States]], killing four people. [https://www.kcbd.com/2023/03/08/4-killed-when-2-small-planes-collide-over-florida-lake/ (AP via KCBD-TV)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Georgian protests]]
**Violent protests occur in [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] in opposition to a new law regarding [[foreign agent]]s. Police are reported to be using [[water cannon]]s and [[tear gas]] to control the protesters. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/georgians-protest-draft-law-media-nonprofits-97688325 (ABC News)] 
*[[2023 Matamoros kidnappings]]
**Two Americans are found dead, and two alive, after they had been kidnapped in [[Matamoros, Tamaulipas]], Mexico, four days earlier. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-64878721 (BBC News)]
*[[President of Argentina|Argentine President]] [[Alberto Fernández]] announces the deployment of hundreds of federal security forces to the city of [[Rosario, Argentina|Rosario]] after an increase in violence between rival [[drug gang]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/argentina-rosario-drug-violence-security-army-messi-6ddc40f3d57a4f376d70830cf8e0608b (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Micronesian parliamentary election]]
**Citizens in the [[Federated States of Micronesia]] head to the polls to elect the 14 members of the [[Congress of the Federated States of Micronesia|Congress]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/484382/forum-team-observing-micronesia-general-election (RNZ)]
* [[2023 transport strike in the Philippines]]
** Transport groups in the [[Philippines]] decide to end a one-week [[Strike action|strike]] on its second day, following a meeting with [[Malacañang Palace|Palace]] officials in relation to the [[Public Utility Vehicle Modernization Program]]. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2023/03/09/2250317/marcos-thanks-operators-ending-transport-strike/ (''The Philippine Star'')]
